mapper.select: select id, merchant_id, name, scope_type, owner_store_id, source_template_id, status, cloned_from_theme_id, cloned_from_version_id, updated_at from themes where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{themeId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select id, merchant_id, name, scope_type, owner_store_id, source_template_id, status, cloned_from_theme_id, cloned_from_version_id, updated_at from themes where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and scope_type = 'MERCHANT' and status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1

select t.id, t.merchant_id, t.name, t.scope_type, t.owner_store_id, t.source_template_id, t.status, t.cloned_from_theme_id, t.cloned_from_version_id, t.updated_at from themes t inner join store_theme_bindings b on b.merchant_id = t.merchant_id and b.theme_id = t.id where t.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and t.scope_type = #{scopeType} and t.status = 'ACTIVE'
and b.store_id = #{scopeId} and b.mode = 'FOLLOW_MERCHANT'
order by b.updated_at desc, t.id desc limit 1
select id, name, schema_version, config_json, revision from system_theme_templates where status = 'ACTIVE' order by id
select id, name, schema_version, config_json, revision from system_theme_templates where id = #{templateId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
select id, merchant_id, theme_id, based_on_version_id, schema_version, config_json, revision, updated_by, updated_at from theme_drafts where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId}

select id, merchant_id, theme_id, based_on_version_id, schema_version, config_json, revision, updated_by, updated_at from theme_drafts where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} for update
mapper.update: update theme_drafts set config_json = #{configJson}, schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, based_on_version_id = #{basedOnVersionId}, revision = revision + 1, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} and revision = #{revision}
mapper.insert: insert into theme_drafts (merchant_id, theme_id, based_on_version_id, schema_version, config_json, revision, updated_by, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{themeId}, #{basedOnVersionId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{configJson}, #{revision}, #{updatedBy}, now())

insert into theme_drafts (merchant_id, theme_id, based_on_version_id, schema_version, config_json, revision, updated_by, updated_at) select #{merchantId}, #{themeId}, #{basedOnVersionId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{configJson}, #{revision}, #{updatedBy}, now() where not exists (select 1 from theme_drafts where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId})

insert into themes (merchant_id, name, scope_type, owner_store_id, source_template_id, cloned_from_theme_id, cloned_from_version_id, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{name}, #{scopeType}, #{ownerStoreId}, #{sourceTemplateId}, #{clonedFromThemeId}, #{clonedFromVersionId}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, merchant_id, theme_id, version_no, source_draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, publish_note, idempotency_key, published_by, published_at from theme_versions where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} and id = #{versionId}

select id, merchant_id, theme_id, version_no, source_draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, publish_note, idempotency_key, published_by, published_at from theme_versions where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select id, merchant_id, theme_id, version_no, source_draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, publish_note, idempotency_key, published_by, published_at from theme_versions where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} order by version_no desc limit 1

select id, merchant_id, theme_id, version_no, source_draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, publish_note, idempotency_key, published_by, published_at from theme_versions where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} order by version_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into theme_versions (merchant_id, theme_id, version_no, source_draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, publish_note, idempotency_key, published_by, published_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{themeId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceDraftRevision}, #{schemaVersion}, #{configJson}, #{configHash}, #{publishNote}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{publishedBy}, now())
mapper.select: select s.id store_id, s.store_code, s.name store_name, s.status store_status, b.mode binding_mode, b.theme_id, b.published_version_id from stores s left join store_theme_bindings b on b.merchant_id = s.merchant_id and b.store_id = s.id where s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (#{storeScope} = 'ALL' or exists ( select 1 from merchant_member_stores mms where mms.member_id = #{memberId} and mms.merchant_id = s.merchant_id and mms.store_id = s.id )) order by s.status, s.name, s.id

select s.id store_id, s.store_code, s.name store_name, s.status store_status, b.mode binding_mode, b.theme_id, b.published_version_id from stores s left join store_theme_bindings b on b.merchant_id = s.merchant_id and b.store_id = s.id where s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and s.id = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: insert into store_theme_bindings (merchant_id, store_id, mode, theme_id, published_version_id, updated_by, updated_at) select #{merchantId}, s.id, 'FOLLOW_MERCHANT', #{themeId}, #{versionId}, #{userId}, now() from stores s left join store_theme_bindings b on b.merchant_id = s.merchant_id and b.store_id = s.id where s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE' and (b.id is null or b.mode = 'FOLLOW_MERCHANT') on duplicate key update theme_id = values(theme_id), published_version_id = values(published_version_id), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = values(updated_at)

insert into store_theme_bindings (merchant_id, store_id, mode, theme_id, published_version_id, updated_by, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{storeId}, 'INDEPENDENT', #{themeId}, #{versionId}, #{userId}, now()) on duplicate key update mode = 'INDEPENDENT', theme_id = values(theme_id), published_version_id = values(published_version_id), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = values(updated_at)

insert into store_theme_bindings (merchant_id, store_id, mode, theme_id, published_version_id, updated_by, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{storeId}, 'FOLLOW_MERCHANT', #{themeId}, #{versionId}, #{userId}, now()) on duplicate key update mode = 'FOLLOW_MERCHANT', theme_id = values(theme_id), published_version_id = values(published_version_id), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_at = values(updated_at)
mapper.select: select s.store_code, s.name store_name, s.status store_status, s.merchant_id, s.id store_id, b.theme_id, v.id version_id, v.version_no, v.schema_version, v.config_json, v.config_hash from stores s inner join store_theme_bindings b on b.merchant_id = s.merchant_id and b.store_id = s.id inner join theme_versions v on v.merchant_id = b.merchant_id and v.id = b.published_version_id where (s.store_code = #{storeCode} or cast(s.id as char) = #{storeCode}) and s.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into theme_preview_sessions (merchant_id, store_id, theme_id, draft_id, draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, token_hash, created_by, expires_at, created_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{storeId}, #{themeId}, #{draftId}, #{draftRevision}, #{schemaVersion}, #{configJson}, #{tokenHash}, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt}, now())
mapper.select: select id, merchant_id, store_id, theme_id, draft_id, draft_revision, schema_version, config_json, token_hash, created_by, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at from theme_preview_sessions where token_hash = #{tokenHash} limit 1
mapper.update: update theme_preview_sessions set revoked_at = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{sessionId} and created_by = #{userId} and revoked_at is null
mapper.select: select p.id preview_id, p.theme_id, s.store_code, s.name store_name, p.merchant_id, p.draft_revision, p.schema_version, p.config_json, p.expires_at from theme_preview_sessions p inner join stores s on s.id = p.store_id and s.merchant_id = p.merchant_id where p.token_hash = #{tokenHash} and p.revoked_at is null and p.expires_at > now() and s.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
